focus: Ideal core-and-adapter boundary and standards conformance
noveltyJustification: The architecture and standards findings are new, though the target-resolution and note-state items extend defects recorded in earlier iterations.
answeredQuestions: What is the ideal core-and-adapter architecture, and which sk-code-skilled surface checklist items and sk-doc standards remain unmet?

label: The CLI path, handoff section names, seed phrase and default hop cap are duplicated across the core, adapters and wrapper, so a change needs synchronized edits.
There is no shared adapter conformance suite, so malformed seeds, spec-folder normalization and corrupt-note behavior diverge without a cross-runtime test failing.
Killer target resolution and note-state classification belong in the core but are reimplemented in adapters, including two inconsistent note-state rules in the OpenCode plugin.
The nudge's exact-shape note block shows a placeholder in the spec_folder value slot, inviting a copied invalid value that prepare rejects.
The tests README omits the OpenCode plugin suite from its coverage statement and directory inventory.
